figurative_meaning_en: loss of relish for rice due to overeating
similar_in_english: too much of a good thing
example_sentences_in_bangla: অতিরিক্ত খাওয়ার পর তার ভাতাসি হয়ে গেছে।
দিনরাত একই খাবার খেয়ে সে ভাতাসি অনুভব করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After overeating, he has developed a distaste for rice.
Eating the same food day and night, she feels a revulsion towards rice.
note: This idiom reflects the staple role of rice in Bengali cuisine and the cultural emphasis on moderation in eating.
